citations.snippet: # CiteRAG reference guide CiteRAG answers questions about uploaded documents with source citations. CiteRAG accepts PDF, Markdown, and plain text files. The maximum upload size is 20 MB per file. PDF page numbers are preserved as one-based page numbers in chunk metadata. Document text is split into overlapping chunks within each page. The default embedding model is text-embedding-3-small. ChromaDB stores document vectors in a persistent local collection. SQLite stores document names, chunk counts, and ingestion timestamps. Retrieval similarity measures vector closeness and does not prove factual correctness. Citation identifiers are checked against the chunks retrieved for the current question.
